name: Better Cores
description: The WARP engine other plugins build on: an AmneziaWG client in the plugin that checks a Cloudflare WARP account and endpoint through a real tunnel and scans Cloudflare's endpoints for the quickest. It has no page; Better WARP requires it. (The cores overview it used to have is gone: the panel's Cores page shows the cores.)
